title: Launch a project bound to a custom provider
statement: Give `bin/start-kiln.mjs` the credential declaration and provider configuration a custom-provider project was set up with, so `checkLaunch` can evaluate that project instead of refusing it with `unsupported-credential-contract`, and the supervisor can start it. Setup already proves such a project; this task owns only starting it.
notes: Created 2026-09-24 from TSK-0037's STILL OWED note (D25, D13), which TSK-0037's acceptance did not cover. TSK-0063 depends on it: its journey binds the TSK-0062 fixture, a custom provider, and cannot reach a running Kiln until this lands. The launcher's own refusal codes (owed against CMP-0037) are not part of this task. ⚠️ IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0141, commits c3c8fd0, 8ab0b16, 1d0ee30). The declaration lives on this host's model-use grant (`modelUse.credentialVar`), never committed. ACC-0116 is left not-evaluated for review. ⚠️ REVISED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0142, commits 8db3f35, fc7d72b, 19e487c) after review findings F11 to F14: the variable is confirmed with the model and a new one asks again; setup refuses before the live check when it cannot be kept; setup and launch refuse when Pi's models.json reads another route; and a real start and stop is measured. ACC-0116 is left not-evaluated for review.
